arcane.name: Force Barrage
arcane.notes: Always carry. No roll, no save. 1-action mode for third action, or scale up for more missiles.

arcane.name: Dehydrate
arcane.notes: Premier prepared caster AoE. Good single-target too. Fort diversifies from Reflex-heavy options.

arcane.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
arcane.notes: Attack roll. 3-action version: roller's advantage + half on miss. Levels 1–2 star.

arcane.name: Live Wire
arcane.notes: Attack roll. Another AC-targeting option for defense diversity.

arcane.name: Floating Flame
arcane.notes: Great sustain-and-weave. Ping-pong between targets. Replaced by Cinder Swarm at R4.

arcane.name: Ignite Fireworks
arcane.notes: Dazzled on success = very reliable rider. Good early.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆2
arcane.notes: Scales linearly. Still the best 'I don't know what to target.'

arcane.name: Dehydrate H⬆2
arcane.notes: Persistent damage grows. Area grows every 2 heightened ranks.

arcane.name: Ash Cloud
arcane.notes: Zoning + persistent fire + potential blinding. Fort targeting. Good vs bosses.

arcane.name: Lightning Bolt
arcane.notes: Better than Fireball for prepared casters. Incredible vs 2 targets, not embarrassing single-target.

arcane.name: Fireball
arcane.notes: Classic AoE. 20ft burst easy to aim. Embarrassing single-target — pair with coverage spells.

arcane.name: Cave Fangs
arcane.notes: AoE + difficult terrain rider. Outclassed by Howling Blizzard at R5.

arcane.name: Agonizing Despair
arcane.notes: Will-targeting damage. Replaces Fear for the Frightened role. Arcane's exclusive advantage.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆3
arcane.notes: 3 missiles. Reliable as ever.

arcane.name: Dehydrate H⬆3
arcane.notes: Persistent and area keep growing. Fort targeting stays valuable.

arcane.name: Floating Flame H⬆3
arcane.notes: Still serviceable. Last rank before Cinder Swarm replaces it.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm
arcane.notes: Criminally underrated. Force movement rider. Dual mode: fire ants (bosses, Fort) vs fireflies (crowds, Ref/Incap). Scales +2d6/rank. Replaces Floating Flame.

arcane.name: Vision of Death
arcane.notes: Will-targeting damage+debuff hybrid. 120ft range. Serves as damage OR debuff from one slot. Prepared caster favorite.

arcane.name: Wall of Fire
arcane.notes: Fire-and-forget zoning. Combine with forced movement for double/triple damage dips.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆4
arcane.notes: 4 missiles.

arcane.name: Dehydrate H⬆4
arcane.notes: Still competitive. Persistent damage ticks add up.

arcane.name: Lightning Bolt H⬆4
arcane.notes: Same damage as a native-rank Thunderstrike. Multi-tool.

arcane.name: Fireball H⬆4
arcane.notes: Heightens OK. Decent mid-tier AoE.

arcane.name: Howling Blizzard
arcane.notes: Replaces Cave Fangs / Fireball role at this rank.

arcane.name: Wall of Stone
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R5. Best control spell in the game. Always prepare at native rank.

arcane.name: Freezing Rain
arcane.notes: Effectively no-save Slowed 1–2 on enemies via difficult terrain. Then starts dealing damage. Requires party coordination.

arcane.name: Elemental Breath
arcane.notes: 6 element choices. Different damage type + rider per element. Prone on failure. Maximum flexibility per slot.

arcane.name: Geyser
arcane.notes: Below-par damage but prone on failure = very reliable rider.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆5
arcane.notes: Now clearly outpaces Floating Flame. Force movement + persistent.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆5
arcane.notes: 5 missiles.

arcane.name: Dehydrate H⬆5
arcane.notes: At level 13, 'definitely wins more cleanly' vs heightened Fireball (per Mathfinder).

arcane.name: Lightning Bolt H⬆5
arcane.notes: Still multi-tool viable.

arcane.name: Chain Lightning
arcane.notes: Incredible multi-tool but ~18.5% chance 3+ targets take zero. Same damage as R6 Thunderstrike single-target. Great flexibility for prepared casters.

arcane.name: Phantasmal Calamity
arcane.notes: Will-targeting AoE damage. Stunned on crit fail = removed from fight. Amazing with 4+ targets.

arcane.name: Disintegrate
arcane.notes: Big single-target. Expected answer to Wall of Force. Fort targeting.

arcane.name: Wall of Force
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R6. Uncontested indoor area denial. Invisible. Automatic.

arcane.name: Vitrifying Blast
arcane.notes: Below-par damage but Slowed → potentially Petrified over 3 rounds. Fire-and-forget debuff loop.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆6
arcane.notes: Scales fast. 9d6+persistent at this rank.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆6
arcane.notes: 6 missiles.

arcane.name: Dehydrate H⬆6
arcane.notes: Outperforms heightened Fireball at this point.

arcane.name: Eclipse Burst
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R7. 18d6 vs Fireball's 14d6 at same rank. Blinding on crit fail. So large it needs party coordination.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆7
arcane.notes: Still a premium sustain option alongside big spike spells.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆7
arcane.notes: 7 missiles. Auto-hit never stops being relevant.

arcane.name: Dehydrate H⬆7
arcane.notes: Area is getting huge. Persistent damage serious.

arcane.name: Chain Lightning H⬆7
arcane.notes: Extra damage per target. Multi-tool.

arcane.name: Arctic Rift
arcane.notes: Fort-targeting blast with good rider on failure.

arcane.name: Summon Elemental Herald
arcane.notes: Incarnate. Arrival + departure = massive value. Departure turn gives all 3 actions free. Many stat blocks per slot.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆8
arcane.notes: 8 missiles.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆8
arcane.notes: Premium sustain at this rank.

arcane.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆8
arcane.notes: Still the premier Reflex AoE.

arcane.name: Phantasmagoria
arcane.notes: Will-targeting AoE. Confused enemies can't react, can't cast, attack random targets. Very ally-friendly.

arcane.name: Falling Stars
arcane.notes: One of the best blasts for large battlefields.

arcane.name: Unspeakable Shadow
arcane.notes: Top of the Frightened line. Replaces Vision of Death for single-target Will damage.

arcane.name: Summon Draconic Legion
arcane.notes: Incarnate. Arrival + departure.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆9
arcane.notes: 9 missiles.

arcane.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆9
arcane.notes: Heightens well.

arcane.name: Shadow Army
arcane.notes: Will-targeting AoE at the capstone.

arcane.name: Force Barrage H⬆10
arcane.notes: 10 missiles.

arcane.name: Falling Stars H⬆10
arcane.notes: Heightened.

arcane.name: Fear
arcane.notes: Multi-target Frightened. Good at R1–2. At R3, Agonizing Despair is the better Frightened option.

arcane.name: Befuddle
arcane.notes: Silver bullet vs enemy casters. Cut when facing non-casters.

arcane.name: Leaden Steps
arcane.notes: Pick reduced speed OR Clumsy OR both. Good vs mobile enemies (fey).

arcane.name: Dehydrate
arcane.notes: Enfeebled rider on top of persistent damage. Fort diversification.

arcane.name: Laughing Fit
arcane.notes: Silver bullet vs reaction-heavy enemies. Directly counters dangerous reactions.

arcane.name: Entangling Flora
arcane.notes: Auto–difficult terrain, no save. Value multiplied by scouting and positioning. Stays relevant at any rank.

arcane.name: Fear H⬆2
arcane.notes: Multi-target Frightened with better DC. Last rank before Agonizing Despair takes over.

arcane.name: Revealing Light
arcane.notes: Silver bullet vs invisible enemies. Also applies Dazzled.

arcane.name: Slow
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R3. Premier Fort-targeting action denial. Slowed 1 on success, Slowed 2 on failure. Stays relevant at any rank — action denial scales with enemy level, not spell rank.

arcane.name: Hypnotize
arcane.notes: Auto-dazzle regardless of save result. More on failure. Reliable control/debuff hybrid.

arcane.name: Agonizing Despair
arcane.notes: Replaces Fear for Frightened role. Will-targeting damage + Frightened rider. Arcane exclusive.

arcane.name: Earthbind
arcane.notes: Silver bullet vs flyers. Grounds them.

arcane.name: Vision of Death
arcane.notes: Replaces Agonizing Despair for Frightened+damage role. 120ft range. Multimodal (damage OR debuff from one slot).

arcane.name: Containment
arcane.notes: Reflex-targeting action denial. Sealed in sphere. Pairs with Slow for defense variety.

arcane.name: Rust Cloud
arcane.notes: Zoning + persistent damage + Dazzled. Concealment both ways — mitigate with Blind Fight or gauze masks.

arcane.name: Sliding Blocks
arcane.notes: Auto-effect terrain manipulation.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm (fire ants)
arcane.notes: Force movement breaks grabs every turn via sustain. Also damage. Silver bullet vs grab-based enemies.

arcane.name: Wall of Fire
arcane.notes: Zoning. Enemies cannot stay in the area. Combine with forced movement.

arcane.name: Wall of Stone
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R5. Best control spell in the game. Auto-block. Always native rank.

arcane.name: Freezing Rain
arcane.notes: Effectively no-save Slowed 1–2 via difficult terrain + then damage + Slowed. Requires party coordination.

arcane.name: Slow H⬆5
arcane.notes: Still great from a mid-tier slot. Action denial doesn't care about rank.

arcane.name: Entangling Flora H⬆5
arcane.notes: Auto–difficult terrain. Rank doesn't matter for the terrain effect.

arcane.name: Vision of Death H⬆5
arcane.notes: Competes directly with Synesthesia at R5 (but Synesthesia isn't Arcane). +2d6 damage per rank above R4.

arcane.name: Wall of Force
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R6. Uncontested indoor area denial. Invisible.

arcane.name: Phantasmal Calamity
arcane.notes: Will-targeting AoE. Stunned full round on crit fail. Amazing with 4+ targets.

arcane.name: Vitrifying Blast
arcane.notes: Slowed → potentially Petrified over 3 rounds. Fire-and-forget debuff.

arcane.name: Unexpected Transposition
arcane.notes: Swap positions with an enemy reactively. Uncommon — check availability.

arcane.name: Slow H⬆6
arcane.notes: Fort action denial. Stays relevant.

arcane.name: Eclipse Burst
arcane.notes: Blinding on crit fail = devastating control from a damage spell.

arcane.name: Phantasmagoria
arcane.notes: Confused enemies can't react, can't cast, attack random targets. Top-tier Will AoE debuff.

arcane.name: Unspeakable Shadow
arcane.notes: Replaces Vision of Death for Frightened role. Top of the permission tree.

arcane.name: Shadow Army
arcane.notes: Will-targeting AoE control at the capstone.

arcane.name: Sure Strike
arcane.notes: Fortune on next attack roll. Great third action. Pairs with attack-roll spells or a bow.

arcane.name: Tailwind
arcane.notes: Speed boost for an hour. 'Your GM will probably ban it.'

arcane.name: Longstrider
arcane.notes: Speed boost for an hour. More conservative than Tailwind.

arcane.name: Blur
arcane.notes: Concealed (20% miss chance) for 1 minute. Solid defensive buff at any rank.

arcane.name: Resist Energy
arcane.notes: Resist one energy type. Mandatory pick. Heightens for more resistance.

arcane.name: Invisibility
arcane.notes: Invisible until attack. Scouting, positioning.

arcane.name: See the Unseen
arcane.notes: See invisible creatures for 10 minutes. Counter to invisibility.

arcane.name: False Vitality
arcane.notes: Temporary HP. Cast before combat from a low-rank slot for free combat value.

arcane.name: Haste
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R3. Quickened (extra Strike or Stride) for 1 minute. Huge party tempo shift.

arcane.name: Blur H⬆3
arcane.notes: 20% miss chance is 20% miss chance at any rank.

arcane.name: Resist Energy H⬆3
arcane.notes: More resistance.

arcane.name: Fly
arcane.notes: CAN'T MISS at R4. Fly Speed for 5 minutes. Someone always needs this.

arcane.name: Fire Shield
arcane.notes: Resist cold + fire retort damage. Defensive + offensive.

arcane.name: Invisibility Curtain
arcane.notes: One-way invisibility wall. Creative battlefield manipulation.

arcane.name: Haste H⬆4
arcane.notes: Quickened is quickened. Doesn't scale with rank.

arcane.name: Drop Dead
arcane.notes: Appear to die, turn invisible. Uncommon — check availability.

arcane.name: Haste H⬆5
arcane.notes: Still Quickened. Still great.

arcane.name: Fly H⬆5
arcane.notes: Flight from a mid-tier slot.

arcane.name: Haste H⬆6
arcane.notes: Still relevant if you need it from a top slot.

arcane.name: True Target
arcane.notes: Multiple attacks against one creature get fortune. Martial force multiplier. Boss fights.

arcane.name: Energy Aegis
arcane.notes: Resist acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, void. Blanket resistance. Late-game defensive powerhouse.

arcane.name: Illusory Object
arcane.notes: Creative battlefield manipulation — wall, trap, divide, escape. Many uses per slot. Useful at level 20 from a R1 slot.

arcane.name: Befuddle
arcane.notes: Enemy spellcasters. Cut when facing non-casters.

arcane.name: Laughing Fit
arcane.notes: Enemy has dangerous reactions. Direct counter.

arcane.name: Acid Grip
arcane.notes: Ally grabbed/restrained. Forced movement ends grab. Also good general forced movement.

arcane.name: Revealing Light
arcane.notes: Enemy is invisible. Direct counter.

arcane.name: Earthbind
arcane.notes: Enemy has flight. Grounds them.

arcane.name: Cinder Swarm
arcane.notes: Sustained grab counter — moves grabbed enemy every turn. Also damage.

arcane.name: Disintegrate
arcane.notes: Enemy has Wall of Force. Expected answer.

arcane.name: Interposing Earth
arcane.notes: Block incoming damage.

arcane.name: Shattering Gem
arcane.notes: Shield-like mitigation.

arcane.name: Hidebound
arcane.notes: Absorb a hit. Heighten for more absorption.

arcane.name: Brine Dragon Bile
arcane.notes: Offensive — damage when slashing/piercing happens near you.

arcane.name: Propulsive Breeze
arcane.notes: Utility — battlefield repositioning for ally.

arcane.name: Wooden Double
arcane.notes: Takes a crit for you.

arcane.name: Zephyr Slip
arcane.notes: Reactive repositioning. Heighten to R6 to carry an adjacent ally, R8 to carry friends.

arcane.name: Drop Dead
arcane.notes: Appear to die, turn invisible. Uncommon.

arcane.name: Unexpected Transposition
arcane.notes: Swap positions reactively. Uncommon.

arcane.name: Force Barrage (1-action mode)
arcane.notes: Poke damage, no roll needed.

arcane.name: Sure Strike
arcane.notes: Fortune on next attack roll.

arcane.name: Timely Tutor
arcane.notes: Better Recall Knowledge.

arcane.name: Time Jump
arcane.notes: Escape sticky situations.

arcane.name: Tailwind / Longstrider
arcane.notes: Speed boost for 1 hour.

arcane.name: Illusory Object
arcane.notes: Scouting, creative problem-solving, division.

arcane.name: False Vitality
arcane.notes: Temporary HP before combat.

arcane.name: Resist Energy
arcane.notes: Energy resistance if you know what's coming.

arcane.name: See the Unseen
arcane.notes: Detect invisible enemies for 10 min.

arcane.name: Invisibility
arcane.notes: Scouting, pre-combat positioning.

arcane.name: Gecko Grip / Spider Climb
arcane.notes: Climbing.

arcane.name: Endure Elements
arcane.notes: Environmental protection.

divine.name: Concordant Choir
divine.notes: 1-3 actions, scales with actions spent. Fort targeting. Your flexible damage workhorse at all ranks.

divine.name: Harm
divine.notes: 1-3 actions. Anti-living damage (or anti-undead via Heal). 3-action AoE mode. Always heighten to max.

divine.name: Spiritual Weapon
divine.notes: Auto-hit, sustained. Good action economy — cast then sustain as a 1-action poke. Drops off when native options outclass it (~R5).

divine.name: Inner Radiance Torrent
divine.notes: Rare Reflex-targeting option for Divine. Line AoE.

divine.name: Sudden Blight
divine.notes: Fort-targeting AoE void damage. Solid early.

divine.name: Concordant Choir H⬆2
divine.notes: Scales well. Still your flexible damage pick.

divine.name: Harm H⬆2
divine.notes: More damage, bigger AoE heal/harm. Always heighten.

divine.name: Searing Light
divine.notes: Attack roll. Extra damage vs undead and fiends — silver bullet in those campaigns.

divine.name: Chilling Darkness
divine.notes: Attack roll. Counterpart to Searing Light. Extra damage vs celestials.

divine.name: Vampiric Feast
divine.notes: Fort-targeting damage + you heal. Efficient for attrition.

divine.name: Concordant Choir H⬆3
divine.notes: Still competitive as flexible Fort damage.

divine.name: Harm H⬆3
divine.notes: Keeps scaling.

divine.name: Spiritual Weapon H⬆3
divine.notes: Last rank where sustain value clearly competes.

divine.name: Divine Wrath
divine.notes: Fort-targeting AoE. Sickened on failure — strong rider. Spirit damage is hard to resist.

divine.name: Holy Cascade
divine.notes: Reflex-targeting AoE. One of your few Ref options — prepare when you need the coverage.

divine.name: Enervation
divine.notes: Fort-targeting. Drained condition on failure is devastating vs bosses.

divine.name: Seal Fate
divine.notes: Fort-targeting. Doomed condition — one of the nastiest debuffs in the game. Damage + debuff hybrid.

divine.name: Concordant Choir H⬆4
divine.notes: Last rank where heightened Choir clearly competes with native options.

divine.name: Harm H⬆4
divine.notes: Always heighten.

divine.name: Flame Strike
divine.notes: Classic Divine AoE. Reflex targeting — rare for this tradition. Fire + spirit damage.

divine.name: Shadow Blast
divine.notes: Target's choice of Ref or Will — they pick their lower save. Flexible damage types.

divine.name: Abyssal Plague
divine.notes: Fort-targeting. Drained + Sickened riders. Condition stacking on failure.

divine.name: Harm H⬆5
divine.notes: Keeps scaling. 3-action AoE mode is serious at this rank.

divine.name: Spirit Blast
divine.notes: Force damage bypasses most resistances. Fort-targeting AoE. Premium damage option.

divine.name: Harm H⬆6
divine.notes: Always heighten.

divine.name: Flame Strike H⬆6
divine.notes: Heightened Reflex AoE. Still your main Ref option.

divine.name: Divine Decree
divine.notes: Fort-targeting AoE. Alignment-based damage + conditions. Campaign-dependent value.

divine.name: Eclipse Burst
divine.notes: Best Reflex AoE available to Divine. Blinding on crit fail. Massive area.

divine.name: Sunburst
divine.notes: Reflex-targeting. Extra damage vs undead. Blinding rider.

divine.name: Harm H⬆7
divine.notes: Still scaling.

divine.name: Divine Armageddon
divine.notes: Fort-targeting AoE. Top-end Divine blast.

divine.name: Harm H⬆8
divine.notes: Premium.

divine.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆8
divine.notes: Still the premier Reflex AoE.

divine.name: Wails of the Damned
divine.notes: Fort-targeting AoE. Top-end damage.

divine.name: Harm H⬆9
divine.notes: Max heighten.

divine.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆9
divine.notes: Heightens well.

divine.name: Harm H⬆10
divine.notes: Capstone heighten.

divine.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆10
divine.notes: Heightened.

divine.name: Fear
divine.notes: Multi-target Frightened. Good at R1-2. At R3, Agonizing Despair is the better Frightened option.

divine.name: Command
divine.notes: Action control — Prone, Flee, etc. Incapacitation trait limits boss use. Good vs mooks.

divine.name: Calm Emotions
divine.notes: Suppresses hostile actions and morale effects in area. Shuts down enemy buffs. Situational but powerful.

divine.name: Revealing Light
divine.notes: Silver bullet vs invisible enemies. Also applies Dazzled. One of few Reflex options.

divine.name: Fear H⬆2
divine.notes: Multi-target Frightened with better DC. Last rank before Agonizing Despair takes over.

divine.name: Agonizing Despair
divine.notes: Replaces Fear for the Frightened role. Will-targeting damage + Frightened rider.

divine.name: Roaring Applause
divine.notes: Will-targeting. Stunned on failure. Good single-target action denial.

divine.name: Sanctified Ground
divine.notes: Auto-effect area. Alignment-based bonuses/penalties in the zone. No save for the terrain effect.

divine.name: Seal Fate
divine.notes: Fort-targeting. Doomed condition — among the most devastating debuffs available. Makes subsequent dying saves harder.

divine.name: Divine Wrath
divine.notes: Damage + Sickened rider. Sickened penalizes all checks and DCs.

divine.name: Enervation
divine.notes: Drained = permanent HP reduction until Restoration. Devastating over long fights.

divine.name: Abyssal Plague
divine.notes: Fort-targeting. Condition stacking — Drained + Sickened on failure.

divine.name: Shadow Blast
divine.notes: Target chooses their save — they'll pick their lower one. Flexible.

divine.name: Agonizing Despair H⬆5
divine.notes: Still strong Will-targeting damage+debuff.

divine.name: Repulsion
divine.notes: Will-targeting area denial. Enemies must save to approach you. Sustained.

divine.name: Seal Fate H⬆6
divine.notes: Doomed doesn't care about rank — the condition is what matters. But higher DC helps.

divine.name: Divine Decree
divine.notes: Multiple conditions on failure. Alignment-based filtering.

divine.name: Eclipse Burst
divine.notes: Blinding on crit fail = devastating control from a damage spell.

divine.name: Heal
divine.notes: Always heighten to max rank. 1-action touch, 2-action ranged, 3-action AoE burst. Your most important spell at every level.

divine.name: Bless
divine.notes: +1 status bonus to attack rolls in emanation. Use R1-R4, then switch to Heroism at R5.

divine.name: Benediction
divine.notes: +1 status bonus to saves vs fear/death effects. Pairs with Bless for pre-combat stacking.

divine.name: Sanctuary
divine.notes: Enemies must save to target the protected creature. Incredible on a healer — cast on yourself and heal freely.

divine.name: Resist Energy
divine.notes: Resist one energy type. Mandatory pick. Heightens for more resistance.

divine.name: Shield Other
divine.notes: Split damage with an ally. Good on Clerics with better HP/AC than the protected ally.

divine.name: Restoration
divine.notes: Removes conditions (Drained, Doomed, Enfeebled, Clumsy, Stupefied). Always have access to this.

divine.name: Revealing Light
divine.notes: Reveals invisible creatures. Also Dazzled rider.

divine.name: Heroism
divine.notes: Replaces Bless at R5. +1 status bonus to attacks, saves, and skills. Keeps getting better heightened (+2 at R6, +3 at R9). CAN'T MISS from R5+.

divine.name: Sanctified Ground
divine.notes: Alignment-based bonuses in area. No save for the buff portion.

divine.name: Heal H⬆3
divine.notes: Always heighten Heal.

divine.name: Fly
divine.notes: CAN'T MISS at R4. Fly Speed for 5 minutes. Someone always needs this.

divine.name: Soothing Spring
divine.notes: AoE healing pool. Out-of-combat recovery.

divine.name: Remove Curse
divine.notes: Removes curses. When you need it, nothing else will do.

divine.name: Resist Energy H⬆4
divine.notes: More resistance.

divine.name: Breath of Life
divine.notes: CAN'T MISS. Reaction to save a dying ally. Often worth a top slot. The spell that makes Divine the best tradition to have in your party.

divine.name: Heroism H⬆5
divine.notes: Now +2 status bonus. Strictly better than Bless. This is when you stop preparing Bless and go Heroism permanently.

divine.name: Heal H⬆5
divine.notes: Always heighten Heal.

divine.name: Fly H⬆5
divine.notes: Flight from a mid-tier slot.

divine.name: Zealous Conviction
divine.notes: Party-wide buff. Temporary HP + bonus to mental saves. Outstanding group support.

divine.name: Field of Life
divine.notes: Sustained AoE healing zone. Strong in prolonged fights.

divine.name: Raise Dead
divine.notes: Brings back the dead. When you need it, you really need it.

divine.name: Righteous Might
divine.notes: Self-buff — grow Large, gain reach and damage. For melee-oriented Divine casters (Warpriest).

divine.name: Heroism H⬆6
divine.notes: +2 status bonus from a top slot. Premium single-target buff.

divine.name: Heal H⬆6
divine.notes: Always heighten.

divine.name: Regenerate
divine.notes: Sustained regeneration. Keeps an ally alive through sustained damage.

divine.name: Energy Aegis
divine.notes: Resist acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, void. Blanket resistance. Late-game defensive powerhouse.

divine.name: Heroism H⬆7
divine.notes: Still +2. Solid from a mid-tier slot.

divine.name: Moment of Renewal
divine.notes: Party-wide condition removal + healing. One spell fixes everything.

divine.name: Heal H⬆8
divine.notes: Massive healing at this rank.

divine.name: Foresight
divine.notes: Tactical awareness buff. Target is never flat-footed, gets bonuses to initiative and Perception.

divine.name: Heroism H⬆9
divine.notes: Now +3 status bonus. Peak Heroism. Capstone buff.

divine.name: Heal H⬆9
divine.notes: Always heighten.

divine.name: Sanctuary
divine.notes: Protect yourself or a squishy ally. Enemies must save to target them.

divine.name: Restoration
divine.notes: Drained, Doomed, Enfeebled, Clumsy, Stupefied — removes debilitating conditions.

divine.name: Revealing Light
divine.notes: Enemy is invisible. Direct counter.

divine.name: Searing Light
divine.notes: Undead and fiends. Extra damage vs these creature types.

divine.name: Remove Curse
divine.notes: Curses. Nothing else works.

divine.name: Breath of Life
divine.notes: Ally drops to 0 HP. Save their life as a reaction.

divine.name: Raise Dead
divine.notes: Someone died. Bring them back.

divine.name: Breath of Life
divine.notes: Save a dying ally. Often worth a top slot AND a low slot.

divine.name: Concordant Choir (1-action mode)
divine.notes: Flexible damage. 1-action for third action, 2 or 3 for more.

divine.name: Harm (1-action mode)
divine.notes: Touch range, single target. Pairs with 2-action spells.

divine.name: Heal (1-action mode)
divine.notes: Touch heal. The classic third action for a Divine caster.

divine.name: Bless
divine.notes: +1 attack rolls in emanation. Cast before initiative if possible.

divine.name: Benediction
divine.notes: +1 saves vs fear/death. Stack with Bless.

divine.name: Sanctuary
divine.notes: Protect yourself before combat. Enemies must save to target you while you heal.

divine.name: Resist Energy
divine.notes: Energy resistance if you know what's coming.

divine.name: Shield Other
divine.notes: Split damage with a frontliner before the fight starts.

divine.name: Restoration
divine.notes: Between-encounter condition removal.

occult.name: Force Barrage
occult.notes: CRITICAL for Occult. Your only reliable non-Mental damage at most ranks. Always carry. No roll, no save. 1-action mode for third action.

occult.name: Phantom Pain
occult.notes: Will-targeting persistent mental + Frightened rider. Damage+debuff hybrid. Drops at R4 when better Will options arrive.

occult.name: Concordant Choir
occult.notes: Fort-targeting sonic. 1-3 action flexibility. Diversifies from Will-heavy options.

occult.name: Spiritual Weapon
occult.notes: Auto-hit sustained force damage. Good action economy with third-action sustain.

occult.name: Inner Radiance Torrent
occult.notes: Rare Occult Reflex targeting. Line shape. Good for defense diversity.

occult.name: Illusory Creature
occult.notes: Auto-hit sustained. Distraction + damage. Good action economy.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆2
occult.notes: Scales linearly. Still the best 'I don't know what to target.'

occult.name: Agonizing Despair
occult.notes: Will-targeting damage + Frightened rider. Replaces Phantom Pain for Frightened role.

occult.name: Vampiric Feast
occult.notes: Fort-targeting. Damage + self-healing. Two roles from one slot.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆3
occult.notes: 3 missiles. Reliable as ever.

occult.name: Vision of Death
occult.notes: Will-targeting damage+debuff hybrid. 120ft range. Serves as damage OR debuff from one slot. Prepared caster favorite.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆4
occult.notes: 4 missiles.

occult.name: Shadow Blast
occult.notes: Target chooses Ref or Will. Versatile damage type. Rare Occult Reflex option.

occult.name: Synesthesia
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R5. Clumsy 3 + tons of riders on failure. Enormous effective damage via AC reduction and outcome shifts. Debuff that functions as damage.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆5
occult.notes: 5 missiles.

occult.name: Phantasmal Calamity
occult.notes: Will-targeting AoE damage. Stunned on crit fail = removed from fight. Amazing with 4+ targets.

occult.name: Spirit Blast
occult.notes: Fort-targeting FORCE damage — non-Mental! Your second reliable damage type after Force Barrage. Works vs mindless/constructs.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆6
occult.notes: 6 missiles.

occult.name: Warp Mind
occult.notes: Will-targeting. Confused (permanent on crit fail). Top single-target Will option.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆7
occult.notes: 7 missiles. Auto-hit never stops being relevant.

occult.name: Uncontrollable Dance
occult.notes: Will-targeting. Slowed + can't use actions effectively. Top-tier single-target lockdown.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆8
occult.notes: 8 missiles.

occult.name: Phantasmagoria
occult.notes: Will-targeting AoE. Confused enemies can't react, can't cast, attack random targets. Very ally-friendly.

occult.name: Unspeakable Shadow
occult.notes: Top of the Frightened line. Replaces Vision of Death for single-target Will damage.

occult.name: Weird
occult.notes: Mass fear — AoE Frightened. Complements Phantasmagoria's Confused with mass debilitation.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆9
occult.notes: 9 missiles.

occult.name: Shadow Army
occult.notes: Will-targeting AoE at the capstone.

occult.name: Force Barrage H⬆10
occult.notes: 10 missiles.

occult.name: Fear
occult.notes: Multi-target Frightened. Good at R1-2. At R3, Agonizing Despair is the better Frightened option.

occult.name: Command
occult.notes: Single-target action control. Forces enemy to use their turn your way.

occult.name: Befuddle
occult.notes: Silver bullet vs enemy casters. Cut when facing non-casters.

occult.name: Phantom Pain
occult.notes: Persistent mental + Frightened. Drops at R4.

occult.name: Lose the Path
occult.notes: Reaction debuff — forces target to waste movement. Free action economy.

occult.name: Hideous Laughter
occult.notes: Slowed on failure. Top-tier single-target Will debuff at this rank.

occult.name: Laughing Fit
occult.notes: Silver bullet vs reaction-heavy enemies. Directly counters dangerous reactions.

occult.name: Calm Emotions
occult.notes: AoE emotional control. Situational but powerful when it applies.

occult.name: Fear H⬆2
occult.notes: Multi-target Frightened with better DC. Last rank before Agonizing Despair takes over.

occult.name: Slow
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R3. Premier Fort-targeting action denial. Slowed 1 on success, Slowed 2 on failure. Complements Will-targeting debuffs. Stays relevant at any rank.

occult.name: Paralyze
occult.notes: Devastating single-target. Paralyzed on failure = off-guard, can't act. Incapacitation trait — mooks only, never bosses.

occult.name: Hypnotize
occult.notes: Auto-dazzle regardless of save result. More on failure. Reliable.

occult.name: Agonizing Despair
occult.notes: Replaces Fear for Frightened role. Will-targeting damage + Frightened rider.

occult.name: Roaring Applause
occult.notes: Silver bullet vs reaction-heavy enemies. Prevents reactions on failure.

occult.name: Vision of Death
occult.notes: Replaces Agonizing Despair for Frightened+damage role. 120ft range. Damage OR debuff from one slot.

occult.name: Confusion
occult.notes: Confused is devastating but Incapacitation trait limits to mooks.

occult.name: Suggestion
occult.notes: Behavioral control. Incap limits to mooks. Social/creative uses shine.

occult.name: Containment
occult.notes: Reflex-targeting action denial. Sealed in sphere. Rare Occult Reflex option.

occult.name: Synesthesia
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R5. Clumsy 3 + Dazzled + reduced speed + flat-footed on failure. Enormously impactful even on success. THE Occult debuff spell.

occult.name: Black Tentacles
occult.notes: Auto-effect area denial. No save to deploy. Grabs and immobilizes.

occult.name: Crushing Despair
occult.notes: AoE Will debuff. Sickened on failure.

occult.name: Synaptic Pulse
occult.notes: AoE Stunned. Will-targeting burst.

occult.name: Chromatic Wall
occult.notes: Auto-effect barrier. Different effect per color.

occult.name: Glimmer of Charm
occult.notes: Single-target charm. Social/creative uses.

occult.name: Slow H⬆5
occult.notes: Still great from a mid-tier slot. Action denial doesn't care about rank.

occult.name: Wall of Force
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R6. Uncontested indoor area denial. Invisible. Automatic.

occult.name: Phantasmal Calamity
occult.notes: Will-targeting AoE. Stunned full round on crit fail. Amazing with 4+ targets.

occult.name: Feeblemind
occult.notes: Devastating vs casters. Stupefied 4 on failure, permanent on crit fail. Single-target annihilation.

occult.name: Dominate
occult.notes: Turn enemy into ally. Incap limits to mooks but devastating when it lands.

occult.name: Slow H⬆6
occult.notes: Fort action denial. Stays relevant.

occult.name: Warp Mind
occult.notes: Confused (permanent on crit fail). Top single-target Will debuff.

occult.name: Mask of Terror
occult.notes: Auto-Frightened aura. No save to activate — enemies must save to approach.

occult.name: Uncontrollable Dance
occult.notes: Slowed + can't use actions effectively. Top single-target lockdown at R8.

occult.name: Disappearance
occult.notes: True invisibility. Auto-effect. Ultimate stealth/escape.

occult.name: Phantasmagoria
occult.notes: Confused enemies can't react, can't cast, attack random targets. Top-tier Will AoE debuff.

occult.name: Unspeakable Shadow
occult.notes: Replaces Vision of Death for Frightened role. Top of the Frightened line.

occult.name: Weird
occult.notes: Mass fear. AoE Frightened.

occult.name: Shadow Army
occult.notes: Will-targeting AoE control at the capstone.

occult.name: Soothe
occult.notes: Occult's Heal equivalent. ALWAYS heighten to max rank. Emotional healing + HP restoration.

occult.name: Bless
occult.notes: +1 status to attack rolls for allies. Heighten to R4 (bigger area), then switch to Heroism at R5.

occult.name: Sure Strike
occult.notes: Fortune on next attack roll. Great third action. Pairs with attack-roll spells or a bow.

occult.name: Blur
occult.notes: Concealed (20% miss chance) for 1 minute. Solid defensive buff at any rank.

occult.name: Invisibility
occult.notes: Invisible until attack. Scouting, positioning.

occult.name: Resist Energy
occult.notes: Resist one energy type. Mandatory pick. Heightens for more resistance.

occult.name: False Vitality
occult.notes: Temporary HP. Cast before combat from a low-rank slot for free combat value.

occult.name: Restoration
occult.notes: Remove conditions and drain. Out-of-combat recovery. Essential utility.

occult.name: Illusory Creature
occult.notes: Sustained distraction. Also deals damage. Good action economy.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆2
occult.notes: Always heighten to max. More HP restored.

occult.name: Haste
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R3. Quickened (extra Strike or Stride) for 1 minute. Huge party tempo shift.

occult.name: Heroism
occult.notes: Status bonus to attacks, saves, and skills. Replaces Bless at R5 — keep heightening from there.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆3
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: Resist Energy H⬆3
occult.notes: More resistance.

occult.name: Fly
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R4. Fly Speed for 5 minutes. Someone always needs this.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆4
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: Haste H⬆4
occult.notes: Quickened is quickened. Doesn't scale with rank.

occult.name: Bless H⬆4
occult.notes: Bigger area. Last Bless rank — switch to Heroism at R5.

occult.name: Heroism H⬆5
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS from R5+. +2 status bonus. Keeps scaling. THE Occult buff from here on.

occult.name: Chromatic Wall
occult.notes: Auto-effect barrier. Different color = different effect.

occult.name: Shadow Siphon
occult.notes: Reaction — reduce incoming spell damage by half. Excellent mitigation.

occult.name: Haste H⬆5
occult.notes: Still Quickened. Still great.

occult.name: Fly H⬆5
occult.notes: Flight from a mid-tier slot.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆5
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: Heroism H⬆6
occult.notes: +2 status bonus at higher DC.

occult.name: Wall of Force
occult.notes: CAN'T MISS at R6. Blocks everything.

occult.name: Haste H⬆6
occult.notes: Still relevant if you need it from a top slot.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆6
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: True Target
occult.notes: Multiple attacks against one creature get fortune. Martial force multiplier. Boss fights. THE reason to play Occult support.

occult.name: Energy Aegis
occult.notes: Resist acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, void. Blanket resistance. Late-game defensive powerhouse.

occult.name: Mask of Terror
occult.notes: Auto-Frightened aura. No save to deploy. Buff for the whole party via enemy debilitation.

occult.name: Heroism H⬆7
occult.notes: +2 status bonus, higher-level DC.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆7
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: Heroism H⬆8
occult.notes: +3 status bonus at R8. Peak Heroism.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆8
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: Heroism H⬆9
occult.notes: +3 status bonus.

occult.name: Soothe H⬆9
occult.notes: Always heighten to max.

occult.name: Illusory Object
occult.notes: Creative battlefield manipulation — wall, trap, divide, escape. Many uses per slot. Useful at level 20 from a R1 slot.

occult.name: Befuddle
occult.notes: Enemy spellcasters. Cut when facing non-casters.

occult.name: Laughing Fit
occult.notes: Enemy has dangerous reactions. Direct counter.

occult.name: Revealing Light
occult.notes: Enemy is invisible. Direct counter.

occult.name: Roaring Applause
occult.notes: Enemy has dangerous reactions. Prevents reactions on failure.

occult.name: Lose the Path
occult.notes: Force wasted movement. Controlling reaction.

occult.name: Shadow Siphon
occult.notes: Reduce incoming spell damage by half. Excellent mitigation.

occult.name: Drop Dead
occult.notes: Appear to die, turn invisible. Uncommon — check availability.

occult.name: Unexpected Transposition
occult.notes: Swap positions reactively. Uncommon — check availability.

occult.name: Force Barrage (1-action mode)
occult.notes: Poke damage, no roll needed.

occult.name: Sure Strike
occult.notes: Fortune on next attack roll.

occult.name: Timely Tutor
occult.notes: Better Recall Knowledge.

occult.name: Time Jump
occult.notes: Escape sticky situations.

occult.name: Illusory Object
occult.notes: Scouting, creative problem-solving, division.

occult.name: False Vitality
occult.notes: Temporary HP before combat.

occult.name: Resist Energy
occult.notes: Energy resistance if you know what's coming.

occult.name: Invisibility
occult.notes: Scouting, pre-combat positioning.

occult.name: Restoration
occult.notes: Remove conditions and drain between encounters.

primal.name: Dehydrate
primal.notes: Premier prepared caster AoE. Good single-target too. Fort targeting diversifies from Reflex-heavy options. Heightens all the way.

primal.name: Horizon Thunder Sphere
primal.notes: Attack roll. 3-action version: roller's advantage + half on miss. Targets AC -- critical for covering Primal's Will gap.

primal.name: Hydraulic Push
primal.notes: Attack roll. Forced movement on hit. Another AC-targeting option -- important for Primal's defense diversity.

primal.name: Heal
primal.notes: Always heighten to max rank. Listed here as a reminder: Heal is ALWAYS worth a top-tier slot. 3-action mode is AoE heal + undead damage.

primal.name: Floating Flame
primal.notes: Great sustain-and-weave. Ping-pong between targets. Replaced by Cinder Swarm at R4.

primal.name: Ignite Fireworks
primal.notes: Dazzled on success = very reliable rider. Good early.

primal.name: Ash Cloud
primal.notes: Zoning + persistent fire + potential blinding. Fort targeting. Good vs bosses.

primal.name: Acid Grip
primal.notes: Forced movement ends grab. Acid damage type diversifies from fire-heavy list.

primal.name: Dehydrate H⬆2
primal.notes: Persistent damage grows. Area grows every 2 heightened ranks.

primal.name: Lightning Bolt
primal.notes: Better than Fireball for prepared casters. Incredible vs 2 targets, not embarrassing single-target.

primal.name: Fireball
primal.notes: Classic AoE. 20ft burst easy to aim. Embarrassing single-target -- pair with coverage spells.

primal.name: Cave Fangs
primal.notes: AoE + difficult terrain rider. Outclassed by Howling Blizzard at R5.

primal.name: Searing Light
primal.notes: Attack roll. Extra damage vs fiends and undead. AC targeting covers Primal's Will gap.

primal.name: Dehydrate H⬆3
primal.notes: Persistent and area keep growing. Fort targeting stays valuable.

primal.name: Floating Flame H⬆3
primal.notes: Still serviceable. Last rank before Cinder Swarm replaces it.

primal.name: Cinder Swarm
primal.notes: Criminally underrated. Force movement rider. Dual mode: fire ants (bosses, Fort) vs fireflies (crowds, Ref/Incap). Scales +2d6/rank. Replaces Floating Flame.

primal.name: Wall of Fire
primal.notes: Fire-and-forget zoning. Combine with forced movement for double/triple damage dips.

primal.name: Rust Cloud
primal.notes: Zoning + persistent damage + Dazzled. Concealment both ways.

primal.name: Dehydrate H⬆4
primal.notes: Still competitive. Persistent damage ticks add up.

primal.name: Lightning Bolt H⬆4
primal.notes: Multi-tool still viable at this rank.

primal.name: Fireball H⬆4
primal.notes: Heightens OK. Decent mid-tier AoE.

primal.name: Howling Blizzard
primal.notes: Replaces Cave Fangs / Fireball role at this rank. Cold damage diversifies from fire.

primal.name: Elemental Breath
primal.notes: 6 element choices. Different damage type + rider per element. Prone on failure. Maximum flexibility per slot.

primal.name: Geyser
primal.notes: Below-par damage but prone on failure = very reliable rider.

primal.name: Wall of Stone
primal.notes: CAN'T MISS at R5. Best control spell in the game. Always prepare at native rank. Also great damage enabler -- trap enemies in your AoEs.

primal.name: Freezing Rain
primal.notes: Effectively no-save Slowed 1-2 via difficult terrain. Then starts dealing damage. Requires party coordination.

primal.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆5
primal.notes: Now clearly outpaces Floating Flame. Force movement + persistent.

primal.name: Dehydrate H⬆5
primal.notes: At level 13, 'definitely wins more cleanly' vs heightened Fireball (per Mathfinder).

primal.name: Lightning Bolt H⬆5
primal.notes: Still multi-tool viable.

primal.name: Chain Lightning
primal.notes: Incredible multi-tool but ~18.5% chance 3+ targets take zero. Great flexibility for prepared casters.

primal.name: Vitrifying Blast
primal.notes: Below-par damage but Slowed → potentially Petrified over 3 rounds. Fire-and-forget debuff loop.

primal.name: Field of Razors
primal.notes: AoE slashing damage + difficult terrain. Physical damage diversifies from energy.

primal.name: Baleful Polymorph
primal.notes: Fort-targeting transformation. Incap -- use on mooks, not bosses.

primal.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆6
primal.notes: Scales fast. 9d6+persistent at this rank.

primal.name: Dehydrate H⬆6
primal.notes: Outperforms heightened Fireball at this point.

primal.name: Eclipse Burst
primal.notes: CAN'T MISS at R7. 18d6 vs Fireball's 14d6 at same rank. Blinding on crit fail. So large it needs party coordination.

primal.name: Volcanic Eruption
primal.notes: Massive AoE fire + persistent fire damage. Leaves difficult terrain.

primal.name: Sunburst
primal.notes: Huge AoE. Extra damage vs undead. Blinding on crit fail.

primal.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆7
primal.notes: Still a premium sustain option alongside big spike spells.

primal.name: Dehydrate H⬆7
primal.notes: Area is getting huge. Persistent damage serious.

primal.name: Chain Lightning H⬆7
primal.notes: Extra damage per target. Multi-tool.

primal.name: Arctic Rift
primal.notes: Fort-targeting blast with good rider on failure. Cold damage.

primal.name: Horrid Wilting
primal.notes: Fort-targeting AoE void damage. Plants and water creatures take extra damage.

primal.name: Earthquake
primal.notes: Auto-damage, no save to avoid the shaking. Prone on failure. Massive area.

primal.name: Whirlwind
primal.notes: Sustained AoE. Physical damage.

primal.name: Cinder Swarm H⬆8
primal.notes: Premium sustain at this rank.

primal.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆8
primal.notes: Still the premier Reflex AoE.

primal.name: Falling Stars
primal.notes: One of the best blasts for large battlefields. Multiple bursts.

primal.name: Implosion
primal.notes: Sustained single-target Fort damage. No save avoids all damage -- success still deals damage.

primal.name: Storm of Vengeance
primal.notes: Sustained auto-damage storm. Escalates each round. Massive area.

primal.name: Eclipse Burst H⬆9
primal.notes: Heightens well.

primal.name: Nature Incarnate
primal.notes: Primal capstone. Transform into a powerful nature avatar.

primal.name: Falling Stars H⬆10
primal.notes: Heightened.

primal.name: Fear
primal.notes: Multi-target Frightened. One of only TWO Will-targeting spells on the Primal list. Keep in low-tier slots throughout career.

primal.name: Lose the Path
primal.notes: Reaction. Your OTHER Will-targeting option. Wastes enemy movement. Reaction = free action economy.

primal.name: Leaden Steps
primal.notes: Pick reduced speed OR Clumsy OR both. Good vs mobile enemies.

primal.name: Dehydrate
primal.notes: Enfeebled rider on top of persistent damage. Fort diversification.

primal.name: Entangling Flora
primal.notes: Auto-difficult terrain, no save. Value multiplied by scouting and positioning. Stays relevant at any rank.

primal.name: Revealing Light
primal.notes: Silver bullet vs invisible enemies. Also applies Dazzled.

primal.name: Fear H⬆2
primal.notes: Multi-target Frightened with better DC. Primal has no replacement for Fear's role -- it stays relevant longer than on Arcane.

primal.name: Slow
primal.notes: CAN'T MISS at R3. Premier Fort-targeting action denial. Slowed 1 on success, Slowed 2 on failure. Stays relevant at any rank -- action denial scales with enemy level, not spell rank.

primal.name: Earthbind
primal.notes: Silver bullet vs flyers. Grounds them.

primal.name: Rust Cloud
primal.notes: Zoning + persistent damage + Dazzled. Concealment both ways -- mitigate with Blind Fight or gauze masks.

primal.name: Cinder Swarm (fire ants)
primal.notes: Force movement breaks grabs every turn via sustain. Also damage. Silver bullet vs grab-based enemies.

primal.name: Wall of Fire
primal.notes: Zoning. Enemies cannot stay in the area. Combine with forced movement.

primal.name: Wall of Stone
primal.notes: CAN'T MISS at R5. Best control spell in the game. Auto-block. Always native rank.

primal.name: Freezing Rain
primal.notes: Effectively no-save Slowed 1-2 via difficult terrain + then damage + Slowed. Requires party coordination.

primal.name: Slow H⬆5
primal.notes: Still great from a mid-tier slot. Action denial doesn't care about rank.

primal.name: Entangling Flora H⬆5
primal.notes: Auto-difficult terrain. Rank doesn't matter for the terrain effect.

primal.name: Baleful Polymorph
primal.notes: Fort-targeting transformation. Incap -- use on mooks, not bosses. Can end encounters against appropriate-level targets.

primal.name: Vitrifying Blast
primal.notes: Slowed → potentially Petrified over 3 rounds. Fire-and-forget debuff loop.

primal.name: Slow H⬆6
primal.notes: Fort action denial. Stays relevant.

primal.name: Eclipse Burst
primal.notes: Blinding on crit fail = devastating control from a damage spell.

primal.name: Earthquake
primal.notes: Auto-prone on failure. Massive battlefield disruption.

primal.name: Arctic Rift
primal.notes: Fort-targeting control + damage at high rank.

primal.name: Storm of Vengeance
primal.notes: Escalating auto-effect storm. Top-tier sustained control.

primal.name: Implosion
primal.notes: Sustained Fort-targeting single-target denial.

primal.name: Heal
primal.notes: ALWAYS heighten to max rank. 1-action touch, 2-action ranged, 3-action AoE burst. The spell that makes Primal unique among blaster traditions.

primal.name: Tailwind
primal.notes: Speed boost for an hour. 'Your GM will probably ban it.'

primal.name: Longstrider
primal.notes: Speed boost for an hour. More conservative than Tailwind.

primal.name: Resist Energy
primal.notes: Resist one energy type. Mandatory pick. Heightens for more resistance.

primal.name: Barkskin
primal.notes: +2 status bonus to AC (replaces Dex cap). Good for low-Dex allies.

primal.name: Animal Form
primal.notes: Combat transformation. Multiple stat blocks per slot. Good for martial-curious casters.

primal.name: Hidebound
primal.notes: Absorb a hit. Heighten for more absorption.

primal.name: Haste
primal.notes: CAN'T MISS at R3. Quickened (extra Strike or Stride) for 1 minute. Huge party tempo shift.

primal.name: Insect Form
primal.notes: Combat transformation. Different stat blocks than Animal Form.

primal.name: Resist Energy H⬆3
primal.notes: More resistance.

primal.name: Fly
primal.notes: CAN'T MISS at R4. Fly Speed for 5 minutes. Someone always needs this.

primal.name: Stoneskin
primal.notes: Physical damage resistance. Good vs martial-heavy encounters.

primal.name: Air Walk
primal.notes: Walk on air for 5 minutes. Alternative to Fly -- different movement style.

primal.name: Fire Shield
primal.notes: Resist cold + fire retort damage. Defensive + offensive.

primal.name: Freedom of Movement
primal.notes: Immunity to grabbed, restrained, slowed, paralyzed, immobilized. Pre-buff staple.

primal.name: Dinosaur Form
primal.notes: Combat transformation with larger stat blocks.

primal.name: Haste H⬆4
primal.notes: Quickened is quickened. Doesn't scale with rank.

primal.name: Elemental Form
primal.notes: Transform into an elemental. Multiple forms per slot.

primal.name: Moon Frenzy
primal.notes: Buff allies with temporary HP and attack bonuses. Party-wide offensive buff.

primal.name: Haste H⬆5
primal.notes: Still Quickened. Still great.

primal.name: Fly H⬆5
primal.notes: Flight from a mid-tier slot.

primal.name: Haste H⬆6
primal.notes: Still relevant if you need it from a top slot.

primal.name: Fly H⬆6
primal.notes: Flight continues to be valuable.

primal.name: Regenerate
primal.notes: Sustained healing over time. Powerful single-target recovery.

primal.name: Energy Aegis
primal.notes: Resist acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, void. Blanket resistance. Late-game defensive powerhouse.

primal.name: Acid Grip
primal.notes: Ally grabbed/restrained. Forced movement ends grab. Also good general forced movement.

primal.name: Revealing Light
primal.notes: Enemy is invisible. Direct counter.

primal.name: Earthbind

primal.name: Brine Dragon Bile

overviews.arcane:
Arcane Tradition

Prepared Caster Spell Planner

Arcane at a Glance
RoleRatingNotes
Damage★★★★ BestAll defense targets, all damage types, best rider effects
Debuffing★★★★ BestWill-targeting blasts (Agonizing Despair, Vision of Death, Phantasmal Calamity) that other traditions lack
Battlefield Control★★★★ BestWalls, terrain, zoning — deepest toolkit
Buffing★★★ GoodHaste, Fly, Blur, Invisibility, True Target — no Bless/Heroism
Mitigation★★★ GoodFalse Vitality, Resist Energy, Fire Shield, reactions
Healing✗ CannotNo Heal, no Soothe. Let the party handle it
Arcane's Superpower
Widest defense coverage of any tradition — all four defenses well-served. You have the luxury of choice. Your job is variety, not specialization.
Defense Coverage
Arcane covers all four defenses well. Damage role should target at least AC + 2 of 3 saves in their top tier slots.
Arcane's advantage: Will-targeting BLASTS. Other traditions get Will debuffs but not Will damage.
Arcane's Gaps

No Healing

  • No Heal, no Soothe, no restorative magic.
  • Options: Wands for out-of-combat recovery, Staves if your class gives access, or make it the party's problem — communicate early.

No Bless / Heroism

  • Your party buff game is Haste, Fly, Blur, Invisibility, True Target — speed, stealth, and accuracy, not raw stat bonuses.

Versatility Cost Warning

  • Arcane has the deepest toolkit for damage, debuff, control, utility, AND silver bullets. If you go full blaster, your party may depend on you for all those other roles too. Consider keeping at least one control and one silver bullet even in your top-tier slots.
Items Reminder
  • Staves → Your best friend as a prepared caster. Grants encounter-to-encounter flexibility you otherwise lack. Budget for a fully upgraded staff.
  • Scrolls → Silver bullets you don't want to burn a preparation slot on.
  • Wands → Repeatable low-rank buffs: Longstrider, See the Unseen, Resist Energy.
overviews.divine:
Divine Tradition

Prepared Caster Spell Planner

Divine at a Glance
RoleRatingNotes
Damage★★ WorkableLimited without class features (Flames Oracle makes it work). Hardest-to-resist damage types (void, vitality, spirit). No Fireball, no Lightning Bolt
Debuffing★★ WorkableFort/Will covered, Reflex weak. Fear, Command, Agonizing Despair available
Battlefield Control★★ WorkableAt higher ranks — no Walls until Eclipse Burst R7, limited terrain options
Buffing★★★★ Best9/10, tied close with Occult 10/10 — Bless, Heroism, Benediction, Zealous Conviction
Mitigation★★★ GoodResist Energy, Shield Other, Sanctuary, Breath of Life
Healing★★★★ BestTied with Primal — Heal, Restoration, Remove Disease, Remove Curse, Breath of Life, Regenerate, Raise Dead, Moment of Renewal
Divine's Superpower
Best buff+heal combination. Cleric is the most forgiving prepared caster (healing font always relevant, Wisdom boosts Perception+Will, better armor/HP). Hardest-to-resist damage types (void, vitality, spirit).
Defense Coverage
Divine covers Fort and Will well. Reflex is the tradition's weakness — accept it and compensate with class features, items, or party composition.
AC: Limited — Searing Light, Chilling Darkness are attack roll options.
Fortitude: Good — Concordant Choir, Sudden Blight, Divine Wrath, Spirit Blast, Enervation.
Reflex: Weak — Inner Radiance Torrent, Holy Cascade, Flame Strike, Eclipse Burst.
Will: Good — Fear, Command, Agonizing Despair, Calm Emotions, Shadow Blast.
Divine's Gaps

No Blasting Without Class Features

  • No Fireball, no Lightning Bolt, no Force Barrage. Damage options are workable but thin.
  • Compensate with class features (Flames Oracle), attack roll spells (Searing Light, Chilling Darkness), scrolls/staves, or lean into buff+heal.

No Haste, No Slow, No Invisibility

  • Heroism instead of Haste (comparable or better impact). Condition-stacking debuffs (Doomed, Drained, Sickened, Frightened) instead of Slow. Sanctuary instead of Invisibility.

No Walls Until R7

  • No Wall of Stone, Wall of Fire, Wall of Force. Eclipse Burst at R7 is your first real area denial. Before that, rely on party members for battlefield control.

Reflex Targeting Is Weak

  • Inner Radiance Torrent (R2), Holy Cascade (R4), Flame Strike (R5), Eclipse Burst (R7) are your options. Don't build around Reflex — accept the gap and target Fort/Will.
Items Reminder
  • Staves — Your best friend as a prepared caster. Grants encounter-to-encounter flexibility you otherwise lack. Budget for a fully upgraded staff. Look for staves with damage options to compensate for Divine's thin blasting.
  • Scrolls — Silver bullets you don't want to burn a preparation slot on. Also: offensive scrolls for gap-filling (off-list damage spells). Scrolls of Breath of Life as backup.
  • Wands — Repeatable low-rank buffs: Bless, Resist Energy, Restoration.
overviews.occult:
Occult Tradition

Prepared Caster Spell Planner

Occult at a Glance
RoleRatingNotes
Damage★★ WorkableMental damage common but fails vs mindless. Force Barrage is your non-Mental lifeline. Psychic makes it work with Unleash Psyche.
Debuffing★★★★ Best (tied)DEEPEST Will-targeting debuff list. Synesthesia, Phantom Pain, Hideous Laughter, Paralyze, Confusion, Feeblemind, Dominate.
Battlefield Control★★ WorkableLimited at low ranks, opens up higher. Black Tentacles R5, Chromatic Wall R5, Wall of Force R6.
Buffing★★★★★ Best10/10 per Mathfinder. Bless, Heroism, Haste, Soothe, Invisibility, True Target. THE buffing tradition.
Mitigation★★★ GoodFalse Vitality, Resist Energy, Blur, Shadow Siphon, Drop Dead
Healing★★★ GoodSoothe (not Heal), Restoration, Vampiric Touch/Feast
Occult's Superpower
Unmatched buffing (10/10) + deepest debuff toolkit. The mind-magic tradition. If your party needs a force multiplier, Occult is it.
Defense Coverage
Occult is weak on AC and Reflex. Your strength is Will (deepest list of any tradition) with solid Fort options. Consider skipping AC entirely and targeting all 3 saves.
Occult's advantage: Unmatched Will-targeting depth — both debuffs AND damage. Plus the best buff suite in the game.
Occult's Gaps

Limited Blast Damage

  • Occult's damage is mostly Mental (useless vs mindless/constructs). Force Barrage at every rank for reliable non-Mental damage.
  • Spirit Blast at R6 for Fort-targeting force damage — non-Mental!
  • Scrolls and wands for elemental damage gap-filling (fire, cold, electricity).
  • Let the party handle damage while you multiply them via buffs+debuffs.

AC and Reflex Targeting LIMITED

  • You can't reliably target AC or Reflex at most ranks.
  • Inner Radiance Torrent (R2, Ref) and Shadow Blast (R5, Ref or Will) are your main Ref options.
  • Containment (R4, Ref) for Ref-targeting control.
  • Accept the gap — your Will depth more than compensates.

Versatility Cost Warning

  • Occult's toolkit is deep in buff+debuff but shallow in damage and control. If your party expects you to blast AND buff, you'll be stretched thin. Communicate your role early — you're the force multiplier, not the artillery.
Items Reminder
  • Staves → Your best friend as a prepared caster. Grants encounter-to-encounter flexibility you otherwise lack. Budget for a fully upgraded staff.
  • Scrolls → Silver bullets you don't want to burn a preparation slot on. Also: elemental damage scrolls to cover the Mental-only gap (fire, cold, electricity).
  • Wands → Repeatable low-rank buffs: Soothe (low-rank out-of-combat), Resist Energy, False Vitality, Invisibility.
overviews.primal:
Primal Tradition

Prepared Caster Spell Planner

Primal at a Glance
RoleRatingNotes
Damage★★★★ BestGreat AoE, good sustained, all physical+energy damage types. Tied with Arcane
Debuffing★★ WorkableWill-targeting is WEAK -- only Fear and Lose the Path. Fort debuffs are strong
Battlefield Control★★★★ BestWalls, terrain, zoning -- tied with Arcane
Buffing★★ WorkableHaste, Fly, Barkskin, Stoneskin -- no Bless/Heroism
Mitigation★★★ GoodReactions, Resist Energy, Fire Shield, Stoneskin
Healing★★★★ BestHas Heal, Regenerate, Moment of Renewal. Tied with Divine
Primal's Superpower
Strongest combined damage+control+healing tradition. The ONLY tradition that can blast AND heal from the same list. You are the most self-sufficient caster in the game.
Defense Coverage
Primal has excellent Fort and Ref targeting but WEAK Will targeting. Compensate with AC-targeting attack roll spells.
Primal's gap: Will-targeting is your blind spot. You have NO Will-targeting blasts. Fear and Lose the Path are your only Will options, and they're debuffs, not damage. Attack roll spells (targeting AC instead of Will) are your workaround.
Primal's Gaps

Will Targeting is WEAK

  • Only two Will-targeting spells: Fear and Lose the Path. Neither deals damage.
  • Attack roll spells (AC targeting) compensate: Horizon Thunder Sphere, Hydraulic Push, Searing Light.
  • Let party members (Bard, Cleric, Occult caster) handle Will-targeting debuffs.

No Befuddle / Stupefied

  • You can't directly counter enemy spellcasters the way Arcane can. Lean on Slow (action denial is class-agnostic) and Wall of Stone (blocks line of effect).

No Bless / Heroism

  • Your party buff game is Haste, Fly, Barkskin, Stoneskin, Moon Frenzy -- speed, defense, and transformation, not raw stat bonuses.

No Force Barrage

  • You lack the auto-hit, no-save damage option. Your reliability comes from Dehydrate (success effect = half damage + persistent) and sustained spells (Cinder Swarm) that deal damage every round regardless of new saves.
Items Reminder
  • Staves -- Your best friend as a prepared caster. ESPECIALLY valuable on Primal casters (per Mathfinder) -- staves can grant access to spells outside your preparation. Budget for a fully upgraded staff.
  • Scrolls -- Silver bullets you don't want to burn a preparation slot on. Also: Will-targeting scrolls from other traditions if your class allows.
  • Wands -- Repeatable low-rank buffs: Longstrider, Resist Energy, Barkskin.
